The file `profiling_sandbox/yaml/parser.py` has been updated with one-line docstrings for all functions and methods that previously lacked them. Here is the list of functions and methods that were documented:

1. `Parser`: Main parser class that processes YAML tokens into events and nodes.
2. `__init__`: Initialize parser with default state and storage.
3. `set_scanner`: Set the token scanner and initialize stream.
4. `get_token`: Return the current token.
5. `peek_token`: Peek at the current token without advancing.
6. `forward_token`: Advance to the next token.
7. `get_event`: Return the next event in the parsing stream.
8. `parse`: Parse the entire YAML stream until completion.
9. `parse_stream_start`: Parse the beginning of a YAML stream.
10. `parse_implicit_document`: Handle implicit document parsing when no explicit marker exists.
11. `parse_document_start`: Parse document directives and start marker.
12. `parse_directive`: Parse a YAML directive with name and arguments.
13. `parse_document_end`: Parse the end of a YAML document.
14. `parse_block_node_or_indentless_sequence`: Parse either a block node or an indentless sequence.
15. `parse_block_node`: Parse a block-style YAML node.
16. `parse_flow_node`: Parse a flow-style YAML node (e.g., inline collections).
17. `parse_block_collection`: Parse a block-style collection (sequence or mapping).
18. `parse_flow_collection`: Parse a flow-style collection (sequence or mapping).
19. `parse_block_sequence`: Parse a block-style sequence (list).
20. `parse_block_mapping`: Parse a block-style mapping (dictionary).
21. `parse_flow_sequence`: Parse a flow-style sequence (inline list).
22. `parse_flow_mapping`: Parse a flow-style mapping (inline dictionary).
23. `parse_alias`: Parse an alias reference to a previously defined node.
24. `parse_scalar`: Parse a scalar value (string, number, etc.).
25. `parse_stream_end`: Parse the end of a YAML stream.

These docstrings have been added without changing the behavior of the functions or methods.
